input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The plugin-enabled Linux AMD64 probe verified the retail VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack call with physical address 0x17AF403C and block-size log2 6. The GPU worker advanced the big-endian readback at descriptor+0x3C through values 25, 49, and 73; exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads that +0x3C field. A clean follow-up GDB run watched the distinct descriptor+0x00 word, object+0x2ABD predicate, current KTHREAD+0x58 and object+13432: the queue stayed at 1, predicate at 0x14, and the two fields at zero; retail helper 0x823B33A0 was not entered during the observed interval. The timeout helper 0x823BA9C8 traps when object+13432 is null, so fabricating its trigger is not a valid fix. New cross-boundary candidate: Process 2 currently passes r3=1 when routing PM4_INTERRUPT callbacks, while exact-XEX callback 0x823B37B8 has distinct r3=0 and r3=1 branches and the ReXGlue import comment labels r3=0 the normal interrupt. The correct PM4-to-callback source mapping and any effect on the queue remain unverified; Process 2 assessment is outstanding. Preserve guest wait and scheduler semantics until that mapping and producer path are traced. Hashes and limitations are recorded in the linked evidence.

X3.note: Process 2's Linux live evidence reports two Vulkan frame submissions from the retail ring under shift-native, with 1,828 PM4 packets and two guest swaps. A synthetic magenta readback rasterized the captured geometry, but the unmodified retail shader readback had zero non-black pixels; the window remained black, two mode-6 rectangles were rejected, and visible retail output/parity remain unverified. The P1 guest wait predicate and exact input-to-generated-executable correlation are still open; no playable frame or scene is claimed.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game's loading screen appeared during a ReXGlue Xbox run. The exact process/build hash was not recorded and the screen is no longer visible. The main menu, retail frame, and offline race remain unverified.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
